description: Follow-up from bedrock-wxf.7 (PR #298). guides/object-storage-s3.md documents the :s3 shorthand; the new backend: {:disk_cache, root: ..., inner: :s3} choice is documented only in Bedrock.ObjectStorage.DiskCache's moduledoc. Add a short section to the object-storage guide: what it caches (immutable chunk/snapshot keys only), what it never caches (bootstrap record, listings, put_if_not_exists), the :max_bytes bound and the evicted telemetry event, and that nothing selects it by default.
title: Document the :disk_cache object-storage backend choice in the guides
